thread:
Eli: Big news day — I accepted the Eng Manager role and also adopted a rescue pup this morning! Meet Biscuit 🐶
Mia: OMG congrats on both!! manager life + puppy life = double chaos but so happy for you :tada:
Aaron: Congrats Eli!! team gets a manager, Biscuit gets a forever home. win-win. when can we see photos? :camera_with_flash:
Eli: sending pics in the thread after this. hes 4 months old and very into chewed sneakers.
Lila: love love love. should we do a little welcome-to-management cake and a tiny puppy welcome kit? I can coordinate.
Jamal: I volunteer to bring training treats and a collapsible water bowl for the office meet-and-greet (if Eli is comfortable with that).
PeopleOpsBot: Reminder: Redwood provides a modest celebration budget for promotions. For pet-related gifts, check local office policy on animals. Submit expenses with tag #life-events.
Eli: thanks all! super low-key on the manager side — excited to support the team. office meet-and-greet for Biscuit would be fun, but Ill check with people who have allergies first.
Mia: photos now!! Biscuit has the best head tilt.
Aaron: definitely a head-tilt champion. congrats again Eli — and welcome Biscuit to the Redwood pack 🐾
Lila: adding a quick poll in the doc: lunch dates for a small manager celebration (weekday noon) + whether folks are cool with a short pup visit.
Eli: appreciate it all, this team is the best. also open to management-level coffee chats if anyone wants to sync.
Jamal: congrats again! also note: leash and treat rules apply :smile:
